posts.title: We stopped a Railway migration 3 weeks out. How to know to stop or go?
posts.description: We took a production Rails app to three weeks before a Railway cutover, then called it off. Here's what Metal, backups, logs, and rollback look like in production, and the questions to answer before you migrate.

posts.title: Building Uscreen’s remote, multi-tenant MCP server inside a Rails app
posts.description: How Evil Martians moved Uscreen’s MCP server into its Rails app as a remote, multi-tenant service: Doorkeeper OAuth, tenant-scoped tools, and dry-run previews for destructive operations.

posts.title: SF Ruby Conference: late bird tickets end Nov 8
posts.description: The SF Ruby Conference has run out of regular tickets, leaving late bird and corporate tickets. But it's never too late! Come meet Ruby friends, play The Pier, join small-group conversations, and explore the 2026 program in San Francisco.
